sql: SELECT service, handler, class, sum(count) AS n FROM sys_invocation_counts GROUP BY service, handler, class ORDER BY service, handler, class

SELECT service, handler, sum(turns) AS turns, sum(completed) AS completed, sum(failed) AS failed, max(p50_ms) AS p50_ms, max(p99_ms) AS p99_ms FROM sys_handler_stats GROUP BY service, handler ORDER BY turns DESC
SELECT hour_ms, sum(completed) AS completed, sum(failed) AS failed FROM sys_handler_history WHERE hour_ms >= 1700000000000 GROUP BY hour_ms ORDER BY hour_ms
SELECT service, handler, sum(count) AS n FROM sys_invocation_counts WHERE class = 'failed' GROUP BY service, handler ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.service, sum(CASE WHEN c.class = 'failed' THEN c.count ELSE 0 END) AS failed, sum(CASE WHEN c.class = 'paused' THEN c.count ELSE 0 END) AS paused, sum(c.count) AS total FROM sys_invocation_counts c GROUP BY c.service ORDER BY failed DESC
SELECT queue, service, object_key, waiting, granted, blocked_on, lock_holder FROM sys_vqueue ORDER BY waiting DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT tenant, hour, invocations, steps, run_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_micros FROM sys_metering ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 48
SELECT id, endpoint, current_for, pinned FROM sys_deployment ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC
SELECT deployment, sum(completed) AS completed, sum(failed) AS failed FROM sys_handler_stats GROUP BY deployment ORDER BY failed DESC
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE root ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE service = 'Shop' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE class = 'paused' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class, transitioned_at FROM sys_invocation ORDER BY transitioned_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, failure_code, failure_message, transitioned_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE class = 'failed' ORDER BY transitioned_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE class IN ('active', 'paused') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, last_failure_message, transitioned_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE class = 'paused' ORDER BY transitioned_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, attempt, retry_at, last_failure_code, last_failure_message FROM sys_invocation WHERE retry_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY retry_at LIMIT 50
SELECT caller_id, service, handler, key, due_at_ms FROM sys_delayed ORDER BY due_at_ms LIMIT 50
SELECT id, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE service = 'Cart' AND key = 'cart-1' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE scope = 'eu' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class FROM sys_invocation WHERE idempotency_key = 'order-42' LIMIT 10
SELECT id, class, status, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE service = 'Approval' AND key = 'order-7' AND kind = 'workflow'
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE parent_id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id
SELECT id, parent_id, service, handler, class FROM sys_invocation WHERE root_id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE schedule = 'nightly' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, tags FROM sys_invocation WHERE tags LIKE '%"env":"prod"%' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class FROM sys_invocation WHERE deployment = 'dp_example' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, class FROM sys_invocation WHERE id LIKE '3fa9%' LIMIT 20
SELECT id, service, handler, class, created_at FROM sys_invocation WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, duration_ms FROM sys_invocation WHERE duration_ms >= 10000 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT id, service, handler, journal_len FROM sys_invocation WHERE journal_len >= 100 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT id FROM sys_invocation WHERE class = 'failed' LIMIT 10000)
SELECT id, service, handler, class, status, attempt, deployment, parent_id, tags, last_failure_message FROM sys_invocation WHERE id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
SELECT index, name, entry_lite FROM sys_journal WHERE id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY index
SELECT offset, kind, body FROM sys_log WHERE id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY offset
SELECT name, records, total_bytes, dropped, last_offset FROM sys_stream WHERE id = '000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY name
SELECT state_key, value FROM sys_state WHERE service = 'Cart' AND key = 'cart-1' ORDER BY state_key
SELECT name, ok, value, failure_code FROM sys_promise WHERE service = 'Approval' AND key = 'order-7' ORDER BY name
SELECT service, key, stage, seq, id FROM sys_vqueue_entry WHERE service = 'Cart' ORDER BY key, seq
SELECT key, scope, has_state, invocations FROM sys_object WHERE service = 'Cart' ORDER BY key LIMIT 50
SELECT name, service, handler, paused, next_at, fired, missed, skipped FROM sys_schedule ORDER BY next_at
SELECT pattern, concurrency, rate, burst, disabled FROM sys_rule ORDER BY pattern
